passages.text: Again the word of the LORD came to me, saying, “Son of man, prophesy and declare that this is what the Lord GOD says: Wail, ‘Alas for that day!’
passages.sermon:
The word of the LORD came to me again.
The LORD spoke to me.
He said, “Son of man, prophesy.
Say these words.
This is what the Lord GOD says.
Cry out in sorrow.
Say, ‘Alas for that day!’”
passages.original: וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר־ יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃ בֶּן־ אָדָ֕ם הִנָּבֵא֙ וְאָ֣מַרְתָּ֔ כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֑ה הֵילִ֖ילוּ הָ֥הּ לַיּֽוֹם׃

passages.text: For the day is near, the Day of the LORD is near. It will be a day of clouds, a time of doom for the nations.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
The Day of the LORD is coming soon.
This day is very near.
Clouds will cover the sky on that day.
This day will bring trouble to many nations.
God will judge the nations on this day.
passages.original: כִּֽי־ קָר֣וֹב י֔וֹם וְקָר֥וֹב י֖וֹם לַֽיהוָ֑ה י֣וֹם עָנָ֔ן עֵ֥ת גּוֹיִ֖ם יִֽהְיֶֽה׃

passages.text: A sword will come against Egypt, and there will be anguish in Cush when the slain fall in Egypt, its wealth is taken away, and its foundations are torn down.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Ezekiel.
The LORD told Ezekiel to prophesy.
The LORD said a sword will come against Egypt.
People will attack Egypt with violence.
Many people in Egypt will die.
Cush will feel great anguish when this happens.
People will take away Egypt’s wealth.
Enemies will destroy Egypt’s foundations.
passages.original: וּבָאָ֥ה חֶ֙רֶב֙ בְּמִצְרַ֔יִם וְהָיְתָ֤ה חַלְחָלָה֙ בְּכ֔וּשׁ בִּנְפֹ֥ל חָלָ֖ל בְּמִצְרָ֑יִם וְלָקְח֣וּ הֲמוֹנָ֔הּ וְנֶהֶרְס֖וּ יְסוֹדֹתֶֽיהָ׃

passages.text: Cush, Put, and Lud, and all the various peoples, as well as Libya and the men of the covenant land, will fall with Egypt by the sword.
passages.sermon:
Cush, Put, and Lud are nations.
Libya is also a nation.
The men of the covenant land are people who have an agreement or alliance with Egypt.
All these nations and peoples are allies of Egypt.
They will fall by the sword.
They will fall together with Egypt.
passages.original: כּ֣וּשׁ וּפ֤וּט וְלוּד֙ וְכָל־ הָעֶ֣רֶב וְכ֔וּב וּבְנֵ֖י אֶ֣רֶץ הַבְּרִ֑ית אִתָּ֖ם בַּחֶ֥רֶב יִפֹּֽלוּ׃פ

passages.text: For this is what the LORD says: The allies of Egypt will fall, and her proud strength will collapse. From Migdol to Syene they will fall by the sword within her, declares the Lord GOD.
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks.
The LORD is powerful and sovereign.
The LORD says the allies of Egypt will fall.
Egypt depends on these allies for support.
Egypt’s proud strength will collapse.
This will happen from Migdol to Syene.
People will fall by the sword throughout Egypt.
The Lord GOD declares this.
passages.original: כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה וְנָֽפְלוּ֙ סֹמְכֵ֣י מִצְרַ֔יִם וְיָרַ֖ד גְּא֣וֹן עֻזָּ֑הּ מִמִּגְדֹּ֣ל סְוֵנֵ֗ה בַּחֶ֙רֶב֙ יִפְּלוּ־ בָ֔הּ נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃

passages.text: They will be desolate among desolate lands, and their cities will lie among ruined cities.
passages.sermon:
God speaks about Egypt and its allies.
They will become desolate.
They will live among other desolate lands.
Their cities will become ruined.
Their cities will stand among other ruined cities.
passages.original: וְנָשַׁ֕מּוּ בְּת֖וֹךְ אֲרָצ֣וֹת נְשַׁמּ֑וֹת וְעָרָ֕יו בְּתוֹךְ־ עָרִ֥ים נַחֲרָב֖וֹת תִּֽהְיֶֽינָה׃

passages.text: Then they will know that I am the LORD when I set fire to Egypt and all her helpers are shattered.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
The LORD will act with power.
The LORD will set fire to Egypt.
The LORD will shatter all Egypt’s helpers.
The people will know that the LORD is God.
passages.original: וְיָדְע֖וּ כִּֽי־ אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֑ה בְּתִתִּי־ אֵ֣שׁ בְּמִצְרַ֔יִם וְנִשְׁבְּר֖וּ כָּל־ עֹזְרֶֽיהָ׃

passages.text: On that day messengers will go out from Me in ships to frighten Cush out of complacency. Anguish will come upon them on the day of Egypt’s doom. For it is indeed coming.
passages.sermon:
The Lord God speaks these words.
On that day, I will send messengers.
These messengers will go out from Me.
They will travel in ships.
They will go to Cush.
They will frighten Cush.
Cush feels safe and secure.
The messengers will remove Cush from its complacency.
Anguish will come upon the people of Cush.
This will happen on the day of Egypt’s doom.
Egypt’s doom is certain.
It is coming.
passages.original: בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא יֵצְא֨וּ מַלְאָכִ֤ים מִלְּפָנַי֙ בַּצִּ֔ים לְהַחֲרִ֖יד אֶת־ כּ֣וּשׁ בֶּ֑טַח וְהָיְתָ֨ה חַלְחָלָ֤ה בָהֶם֙ בְּי֣וֹם מִצְרַ֔יִם כִּ֥י הִנֵּ֖ה בָּאָֽה׃ס

passages.text: This is what the Lord GOD says: I will put an end to the hordes of Egypt by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon.
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks.
He is the one true God.
He will act with power.
He will stop the great armies of Egypt.
He will do this through Nebuchadnezzar.
Nebuchadnezzar is the king of Babylon.
God will use Nebuchadnezzar to defeat Egypt.
passages.original: כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֑ה וְהִשְׁבַּתִּי֙ אֶת־ הֲמ֣וֹן מִצְרַ֔יִם בְּיַ֖ד נְבוּכַדְרֶאצַּ֥ר מֶלֶךְ־ בָּבֶֽל׃

passages.text: He and his people with him, the most ruthless of the nations, will be brought in to destroy the land. They will draw their swords against Egypt and fill the land with the slain.
passages.sermon:
Nebuchadnezzar is the king of Babylon.
He will come with his people.
His people are the most ruthless of the nations.
God will bring them in to destroy the land.
They will attack Egypt with their swords.
They will fill the land with the dead.
passages.original: ה֠וּא וְעַמּ֤וֹ אִתּוֹ֙ עָרִיצֵ֣י גוֹיִ֔ם מֽוּבָאִ֖ים לְשַׁחֵ֣ת הָאָ֑רֶץ וְהֵרִ֤יקוּ חַרְבוֹתָם֙ עַל־ מִצְרַ֔יִם וּמָלְא֥וּ אֶת־ הָאָ֖רֶץ חָלָֽל׃

passages.text: I will make the streams dry up and sell the land to the wicked. By the hands of foreigners I will bring desolation upon the land and everything in it. I, the LORD, have spoken.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is speaking.
The LORD will make the streams dry up.
The LORD will give the land to wicked people.
The LORD will cause foreigners to destroy the land.
The LORD will cause everything in the land to become desolate.
The LORD has spoken these words.
passages.original: וְנָתַתִּ֤י יְאֹרִים֙ חָֽרָבָ֔ה וּמָכַרְתִּ֥י אֶת־ הָאָ֖רֶץ בְּיַד־ רָעִ֑ים וַהֲשִׁמֹּתִ֞י אֶ֤רֶץ וּמְלֹאָהּ֙ בְּיַד־ זָרִ֔ים אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה דִּבַּֽרְתִּי׃ס

passages.text: This is what the Lord GOD says: I will destroy the idols and put an end to the images in Memphis. There will no longer be a prince in Egypt, and I will instill fear in that land.
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks.
The Lord GOD has all power and authority.
The Lord GOD will destroy the idols.
The Lord GOD will remove the images from Memphis.
There will not be a prince in Egypt anymore.
The Lord GOD will put fear into the land of Egypt.
passages.original: כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֞ר אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֗ה וְהַאֲבַדְתִּ֨י גִלּוּלִ֜ים וְהִשְׁבַּתִּ֤י אֱלִילִים֙ מִנֹּ֔ף וְנָשִׂ֥יא מֵאֶֽרֶץ־ מִצְרַ֖יִם לֹ֣א יִֽהְיֶה־ ע֑וֹד וְנָתַתִּ֥י יִרְאָ֖ה בְּאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃

passages.text: I will lay waste Pathros, set fire to Zoan, and execute judgment on Thebes.
passages.sermon:
God is speaking.
God will destroy Pathros.
God will burn Zoan.
God will judge Thebes.
passages.original: וַהֲשִׁמֹּתִי֙ אֶת־ פַּתְר֔וֹס וְנָתַ֥תִּי אֵ֖שׁ בְּצֹ֑עַן וְעָשִׂ֥יתִי שְׁפָטִ֖ים בְּנֹֽא׃

passages.text: I will pour out My wrath on Pelusium, the stronghold of Egypt, and cut off the crowds of Thebes.
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks.
The Lord GOD will act with power and authority.
The Lord GOD will pour out His wrath on Pelusium.
Pelusium is a stronghold in Egypt.
The Lord GOD will cut off the crowds of Thebes.
passages.original: וְשָׁפַכְתִּ֣י חֲמָתִ֔י עַל־ סִ֖ין מָע֣וֹז מִצְרָ֑יִם וְהִכְרַתִּ֖י אֶת־ הֲמ֥וֹן נֹֽא׃

passages.text: I will set fire to Egypt, Pelusium will writhe in anguish, Thebes will be split open, and Memphis will face daily distress.
passages.sermon:
God is speaking.
God will act with power and judgment.
God will set fire to Egypt.
Pelusium will suffer and writhe in pain.
Thebes will be split open.
Memphis will experience distress every day.
passages.original: וְנָתַ֤תִּי אֵשׁ֙ בְּמִצְרַ֔יִם ח֤וּל תָּחִיל סִ֔ין וְנֹ֖א תִּהְיֶ֣ה לְהִבָּקֵ֑עַ וְנֹ֖ף צָרֵ֥י יוֹמָֽם׃

passages.text: The young men of On and Pi-beseth will fall by the sword, and those cities will go into captivity.
passages.sermon:
God speaks about Egypt.
God mentions two cities: On and Pi-beseth.
The young men in On will die by the sword.
The young men in Pi-beseth will also die by the sword.
The people of these cities will go into captivity.
passages.original: בַּח֥וּרֵי אָ֛וֶן וּפִי־ בֶ֖סֶת בַּחֶ֣רֶב יִפֹּ֑לוּ וְהֵ֖נָּה בַּשְּׁבִ֥י תֵלַֽכְנָה׃

passages.text: The day will be darkened in Tahpanhes when I break the yoke of Egypt and her proud strength comes to an end. A cloud will cover her, and her daughters will go into captivity.
passages.sermon:
God speaks about Egypt.
God will act in the city of Tahpanhes.
The day will become dark in Tahpanhes.
God will break the yoke of Egypt there.
Egypt’s proud strength will end in Tahpanhes.
A cloud will cover the city.
The daughters of Tahpanhes will go into captivity.
passages.original: וּבִֽתְחַפְנְחֵס֙ חָשַׂ֣ךְ הַיּ֔וֹם בְּשִׁבְרִי־ שָׁם֙ אֶת־ מֹט֣וֹת מִצְרַ֔יִם וְנִשְׁבַּת־ בָּ֖הּ גְּא֣וֹן עֻזָּ֑הּ הִ֚יא עָנָ֣ן יְכַסֶּ֔נָּה וּבְנוֹתֶ֖יהָ בַּשְּׁבִ֥י תֵלַֽכְנָה׃

passages.text: So I will execute judgment on Egypt, and they will know that I am the LORD.”
passages.sermon: God is the LORD.\r\nGod will judge Egypt.\r\nThe people of Egypt will know God is the LORD.
passages.original: וְעָשִׂ֥יתִי שְׁפָטִ֖ים בְּמִצְרָ֑יִם וְיָדְע֖וּ כִּֽי־ אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃פ

passages.text: In the eleventh year, on the seventh day of the first month, the word of the LORD came to me, saying, “Son of man, I have broken the arm of Pharaoh king of Egypt. See, it has not been bound up for healing, or splinted for strength to hold the sword.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to me.
This happened in the eleventh year.
It was the first month.
It was the seventh day of the month.
The LORD said these words to me.
He called me "Son of man."
The LORD said, "I have broken the arm of Pharaoh."
Pharaoh is the king of Egypt.
His arm is not bound up for healing.
No one has put a bandage on it.
No one has wrapped it to make it strong.
His arm cannot hold the sword.
passages.original: וַיְהִ֗י בְּאַחַ֤ת עֶשְׂרֵה֙ שָׁנָ֔ה בָּֽרִאשׁ֖וֹן בְּשִׁבְעָ֣ה לַחֹ֑דֶשׁ הָיָ֥ה דְבַר־ יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃ בֶּן־ אָדָ֕ם אֶת־ זְר֛וֹעַ פַּרְעֹ֥ה מֶֽלֶךְ־ מִצְרַ֖יִם שָׁבָ֑רְתִּי וְהִנֵּ֣ה לֹֽא־ חֻ֠בְּשָׁה לָתֵ֨ת רְפֻא֜וֹת לָשׂ֥וּם חִתּ֛וּל לְחָבְשָׁ֥הּ לְחָזְקָ֖הּ לִתְפֹּ֥שׂ בֶּחָֽרֶב׃ס

passages.text: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: Behold, I am against Pharaoh king of Egypt. I will break his arms, both the strong one and the one already broken, and will make the sword fall from his hand.
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks.
He is against Pharaoh.
Pharaoh is the king of Egypt.
The Lord will break Pharaoh’s arms.
He will break the strong arm.
He will break the arm that is already broken.
The Lord will make the sword fall from Pharaoh’s hand.
passages.original: לָכֵ֞ן כֹּה־ אָמַ֣ר׀ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהֹוִ֗ה הִנְנִי֙ אֶל־ פַּרְעֹ֣ה מֶֽלֶךְ־ מִצְרַ֔יִם וְשָֽׁבַרְתִּי֙ אֶת־ זְרֹ֣עֹתָ֔יו אֶת־ הַחֲזָקָ֖ה וְאֶת־ הַנִּשְׁבָּ֑רֶת וְהִפַּלְתִּ֥י אֶת־ הַחֶ֖רֶב מִיָּדֽוֹ׃

passages.text: I will disperse the Egyptians among the nations and scatter them throughout the lands.
passages.sermon:
God speaks about Egypt.
God says, “I will act.”
I will send the Egyptians away from their land.
I will spread the Egyptians among many nations.
I will scatter the Egyptians throughout many lands.
passages.original: וַהֲפִצוֹתִ֥י אֶת־ מִצְרַ֖יִם בַּגּוֹיִ֑ם וְזֵרִיתִ֖ם בָּאֲרָצֽוֹת׃

passages.text: I will strengthen the arms of Babylon’s king and place My sword in his hand, but I will break the arms of Pharaoh, who will groan before him like a mortally wounded man.
passages.sermon:
The Lord God speaks.
He will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon.
He will give His sword to the king of Babylon.
He will break the arms of Pharaoh, the king of Egypt.
Pharaoh will groan in pain before the king of Babylon.
Pharaoh will groan like a man who is mortally wounded.
passages.original: וְחִזַּקְתִּ֗י אֶת־ זְרֹעוֹת֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ בָּבֶ֔ל וְנָתַתִּ֥י אֶת־ חַרְבִּ֖י בְּיָד֑וֹ וְשָׁבַרְתִּי֙ אֶת־ זְרֹע֣וֹת פַּרְעֹ֔ה וְנָאַ֛ק נַאֲק֥וֹת חָלָ֖ל לְפָנָֽיו׃

passages.text: I will strengthen the arms of Babylon’s king, but Pharaoh’s arms will fall limp. Then they will know that I am the LORD, when I place My sword in the hand of Babylon’s king, and he wields it against the land of Egypt.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to Ezekiel.
God says He will act.
God will make the king of Babylon strong.
God will give power to the king of Babylon.
God will make Pharaoh weak.
Pharaoh’s arms will become powerless.
God will give His sword to the king of Babylon.
The king of Babylon will attack Egypt with God’s sword.
The people will see this.
They will know that God is the LORD.
passages.original: וְהַחֲזַקְתִּ֗י אֶת־ זְרֹעוֹת֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ בָּבֶ֔ל וּזְרֹע֥וֹת פַּרְעֹ֖ה תִּפֹּ֑לְנָה וְֽיָדְע֞וּ כִּֽי־ אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֗ה בְּתִתִּ֤י חַרְבִּי֙ בְּיַ֣ד מֶֽלֶךְ־ בָּבֶ֔ל וְנָטָ֥ה אוֹתָ֖הּ אֶל־ אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃

passages.text: I will disperse the Egyptians among the nations and scatter them throughout the lands. Then they will know that I am the LORD.”
passages.sermon:
God speaks about Egypt.
God says, “I will disperse the Egyptians among the nations.
I will scatter the Egyptians throughout many lands.
Then the Egyptians will know that I am the LORD.”
passages.original: וַהֲפִצוֹתִ֤י אֶת־ מִצְרַ֙יִם֙ בַּגּוֹיִ֔ם וְזֵרִיתִ֥י אוֹתָ֖ם בָּאֲרָצ֑וֹת וְיָדְע֖וּ כִּֽי־ אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃ס
